source: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

reference: 科學家稱此過程為「刺激輻射排放」，因為原子會受到亮光刺激，放射出光子，而光線就是一種輻射。

source: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

hypothesis: 格南吉爾在1649年建立這座堡垒,

source: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
reference: 1951 年，一場大火使得杜克耶古堡只遺下了一部份的文物，像夏巴尊王的畫像。
hypothesis: 只有一些古董的遺跡才存留,

source: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.
reference: 大火過後，堡壘倖存且受到保護，仍是不丹最令人驚嘆的景點之一。
hypothesis: 堡垒仍是不丹最令人感動的景點之一.

source: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.
reference: 西元 18 世紀中，柬埔寨被夾在兩個強大鄰國間，即泰國和越南。
hypothesis: 柬埔寨在18世紀被兩個強大的鄰國泰國和越南的壓.

source: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.
reference: 泰國人在 18 世紀多次侵略柬埔寨，並在 1772 年摧毀金邊。
hypothesis: 泰國人在18世紀幾次入侵柬埔寨,

source: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.
reference: 在 18 世紀最後幾年，越南人也入侵了柬埔寨。
hypothesis: 越南人也入侵柬埔寨.

source: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.
reference: 委內瑞拉有 18% 的人失業，而大部分受雇的人從事地下經濟的工作。
hypothesis: 委內瑞拉18%的人失業,

source: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.
reference: 三分之二的委內瑞拉工作人口從事服務業，將近四分之一的人從事工業，五分之一的人從事農業。
hypothesis: 委內瑞拉三分之二的人員在服務業工作,

source: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.
reference: 委內瑞拉人的重要產業是石油，僅管只有百分之一的人口在石油業工作，該國卻是石油淨出口國。
hypothesis: 委內瑞拉的石油業很重要,

source: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.
reference: 在國家獨立的初期，新加坡植物園的專業知識協助將此島嶼轉變成一個熱帶花園城市。
hypothesis: 該國在獨立初期, 樹林園的專業技能幫助這座島變為熱帶的花園城.

source: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.
reference: 1981 年，一種蘭花雜交種「卓錦萬代蘭」被獲選為該國國花。
hypothesis: 花是國家的國家花.

source: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.
reference: 每年十月左右，都有將近 150 萬隻草食動物為了雨水，會從北邊的山丘跨越馬拉河，遷移至南方的平原。
hypothesis: 每年十月左右, 接近150萬種草食動物前往南部平原,

source: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.
reference: 四月左右的雨季後，牠們再次跨過馬拉河，然後經由西部回到北方。
hypothesis: 接著再穿過馬拉河,

source: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.
reference: 塞倫蓋蒂區域包括坦尚尼亞的塞倫蓋蒂國家公園、恩戈羅恩戈羅保護區和馬斯瓦野生動物保護區，以及肯亞的馬賽馬拉保護區。
hypothesis: 塞倫蓋蒂地區包含塞倫蓋蒂國家公園,恩哥倫羅保護區和坦桑尼亞的馬斯瓦野生動物保護區,

source: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)
reference: 學習創造互動式多媒體需要常規及傳統技能，也需要在互動式課程中學會的工具（分鏡、聲音及影像編輯、故事編劇等）。
hypothesis: 學習創作互動媒體需要傳統和傳統技能,以及在互動課程中掌握的工具 (故事板,音頻和視頻編輯,故事故事等).

source: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.
reference: 互動式設計需要你重新評估對媒體製作的假設，以及學習以非線性的方式思考。
hypothesis: 透過互動設計, 您可以重新評估媒體製作的假設,

source: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.
reference: 互動式設計需要專案的各個構成要素相互連結，但作為單獨的實體也具有意義。
hypothesis: 互動設計需要項目組件相互連接,

source: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.
reference: 變焦鏡頭的缺點是，達到一定焦距範圍所需的焦點複雜度和鏡片元件數量，遠大於定焦鏡頭。
hypothesis: 焦點距離的不同不同, 顯示焦點距離的不同.

source: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.
reference: 隨著鏡片製造商的鏡片生產達到更高水準，這已不再成為問題。
hypothesis: 眼鏡廠商在製造鏡頭方面達到更高的標準,

source: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.
reference: 這已能使變焦鏡頭拍出與定焦鏡頭不相上下的照片品質。
hypothesis: 這使得焦點距離固定的鏡頭能產生相當高品質的圖像.

source: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.
reference: 變焦鏡頭的另一缺點是鏡頭的最大光圈（速度）通常較低。
hypothesis: 顯示鏡頭的最大光圈 (速度) 通常較低.

source: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
reference: 這就使得平價的變焦鏡頭在低光源、無閃光燈的環境中難以使用。
hypothesis: 這樣便宜的縮細鏡頭在不光的環境下很難使用,

source: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.
reference: 將一部電影轉換成 DVD 格式時，最常見的一種問題是畫面溢出。
hypothesis: 試圖將電影轉換為DVD格式時最常見的問題之一就是過掃描.

source: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.
reference: 多數電視節目的製作目的是取悅一般大眾。
hypothesis: 該國的電視台是如何使用?

source: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.
reference: 因此，你在電視上看到的所有畫面，邊界的上邊、下邊，和側邊都被切掉了。
hypothesis: 沒有任何地方可以看到這些字.

source: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.
reference: 這麼做是為了確保圖像能蓋滿整個螢幕，這個動作稱為「過掃描」。
hypothesis: 這樣才能確保圖像覆蓋整個屏幕.

source: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
reference: 問題是，製作 DVD 時，邊緣很可能也會被切掉，如果影片中的字幕太靠近底部，就沒辦法完整顯示。
hypothesis: 如果影片的字幕太近底部, 影片將會無法完全顯示.

source: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.
reference: 長期以來，傳統的中世紀城堡激發了人們的想像力，使人想起馬上長槍比武、宴會和亞瑟王時代騎士精神的影像。
hypothesis: 傳統的中世紀城堡長久以來激發了想像力,

source: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.
reference: 就算只是站在千年遺址之處，都能輕易回想起久遠之前戰爭的聲音和氣味，幾乎能聽到鵝卵石地上達達的蹄聲，感受到來自地牢坑裡的恐懼氣息。
hypothesis: 難以想像那些早已逝去的戰爭的聲音和氣味, 几乎能聽到子在石頭上的聲,

source: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?
reference: 但我們的想像是否基於現實？最初建造城堡的原因是什麼？它們是如何設計和建造的？
hypothesis: 城堡是一個很重要的建築物,

source: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.
reference: 柯比莫斯洛 (Kirby Muxloe) 城堡在當時極為典型，比較像是加強防守的住家，而非真正的城堡。
hypothesis: 基爾比穆克洛城堡更像是一個堡垒,

source: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.
reference: 它的大玻璃窗和薄牆無法長時間阻擋猛攻。
hypothesis: 沒有任何人能抵擋這座城市.

source: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.
reference: 1480 年代，當黑斯廷斯爵士開始建造這座城堡時，國家當時相對來說和平，只需要抵禦一些四處遊走的小群掠奪者。
hypothesis: 該國的防護只需要對抗小群遊蕩掠奪者.

source: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.
reference: 歐洲國家嘗試維持其國家主權的一種制度稱為權力平衡。
hypothesis: 歐洲國家的國家權力平衡是一個系統,

source: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.
reference: 這其中的概念是，所有歐洲國家必須努力預防單一國家壯大，因此各國政府常常改換同盟來維持平衡。
hypothesis: 歐洲國家必須努力阻止某個國家變得強大,

source: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.
reference: 西班牙王位繼承戰爭成為以權力平衡為核心議題的第一場戰爭。
hypothesis: 沒有任何政治權力,

source: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
reference: 這是一項重大改變，代表歐洲列強不能再以宗教戰爭作為藉口，因此，三十年戰爭成為最後一場宗教戰爭。
hypothesis: 這代表了一個重要的改變, 因為歐洲大國不再有宗教戰爭的借口.

source: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.
reference: 位於艾費蘇斯的阿緹密絲神殿於西元前 356 年 7 月 21 日，因黑若史達特斯蓄意縱火而燒毀。
hypothesis: 希羅斯特拉特在紀元前356年7月21日在一場焚燒事件中摧毀了以弗所的阿特米斯廟.

source: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.
reference: 從故事可知，他的動機來自不計代價獲取聲望。憤怒的以弗所人宣告黑若斯達特斯之名永遠都不會載入史冊。
hypothesis: 希羅斯特拉特的名字永遠不會被記錄.

source: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.
reference: 希臘歷史學家史特拉波後來提到了這個名字，所以我們現在才會知道有這座神殿。神殿毀於亞歷山大大帝出生當晚。
hypothesis: 希臘歷史學家斯特拉波後來記錄了這個名字,

source: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
reference: 亞歷山大作為國王主動提議出資重建神廟，但他的提議遭到否決。亞歷山大死後，神廟才於公元前 323 年被重建起來。
hypothesis: 希臘王亞歷山大提供支付重建神殿的費用, 但他的提案被拒絕.

source: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.
reference: 在正確敲擊所有音符的同時，手部要盡量放鬆，手指也不要有太多不必要的移動。
hypothesis: 請確保手臂盡可能放鬆,

source: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.
reference: 如此您就可以盡可能地降低疲勞。請記住，不需要像彈鋼琴一樣用力敲擊琴鍵來增加音量。
hypothesis: 記得沒有必要用大量的力打鍵,

source: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.
reference: 彈手風琴時，若要增大音量，可更用力或更快速擠壓風箱。
hypothesis: 鼓動的音量也會增加.

source: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.
reference: 神祕主義是追求與終極現實、神性、屬靈的真理、或神之間的交流、認同、或意識覺醒。
hypothesis: 神秘主義是追求與某個極其真實的實際,神性,精神真理或上帝共處,同身或意識意識.

source: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.
reference: 信仰者尋求對神性實相 / 神或眾神的直接體驗、直觀或洞悉。
hypothesis: 相信神是神,也就是神靈,

source: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.
reference: 跟隨者尋求旨在滋養這些體驗的特定生活或修行方式。
hypothesis: 追隨者追求某些生活方式或行為,

source: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
reference: 神祕主義與其它宗教信仰與崇拜能有所分別，是因為它看重個人對於一種獨特意識狀態的直接經驗，尤其是那種平和、洞察、喜悅、甚至是狂喜的特質。
hypothesis: 神秘主義可以從其他形式的宗教信仰和崇拜中區別,

source: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.
reference: 錫克教是源自印度次大陸的宗教。其起源為 15 世紀旁遮普地區自印度教傳統中分裂出來的派別。
hypothesis: 辛格教是一種印度亞洲的宗教. 它起源於十五世紀的龐地區,

source: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.
reference: 雖然他們承認來自印度教的根源與傳統，但錫克教徒認為自身的信仰不同於印度教。
hypothesis: 教徒認為他們的信仰與印度教是獨立的宗教,

source: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.
reference: 錫克教徒將他們的信仰稱為古馬特 (Gurmat)，在旁遮普語中意指「上師之道」。上師是所有印度信仰的基礎，但在錫克教裡，上師構成了整個信仰的重要核心。
hypothesis: 教是所有印度宗教的基本方面, 但在教中, 教已經獲得了重要地位,

source: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.
reference: 此宗教是由古魯那奈克（1469–1539）於 15 世紀所創立。在他之後又依序出現了九位大師。
hypothesis: 這種宗教在15世紀由古魯納納克 (1469年至1539年) 建立.

source: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.
reference: 不過，1956 年 6 月時，波蘭的工人為食物短缺和減薪進行抗議，卻轉變成對共產主義的普遍抗議，這些動亂讓赫魯雪夫的承諾受到考驗。
hypothesis: 克魯什切夫的承諾在1956年6月被考驗,

source: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.
reference: 雖然赫魯雪夫最後派出坦克來恢復秩序，但他還是在某些經濟要求上做出讓步，並同意任命受到愛戴的瓦迪斯瓦夫·哥穆爾卡擔任新總理。
hypothesis: 克魯什切夫卻順利地接受了一些經濟要求,

source: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.
reference: 印度河流域文明是印度次大陸西北部的青銅時代文明，範圍涵蓋現今巴基斯坦的大部分、印度西北及阿富汗東北的部分地區。
hypothesis: 印度河谷文明是印度西北部的銅器時代文明, 包含了現代巴基斯坦大部分地區,

source: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.
reference: 此文明於印度河流域興盛發展，這也是它名稱的由來。
hypothesis: 這座文明在印度河盆地繁榮,

source: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.
reference: 雖然有的學者推測由於該文明也存在於現已乾涸的薩拉斯瓦蒂河流域，因此理應稱其為印度河-薩拉斯瓦蒂文明，而有的學者則以 1920 年代挖掘的第一處遺址哈拉帕為名，稱其為哈拉帕文明。
hypothesis: 儘管有學者認為, 由于文明也存在於現在枯乾的薩拉斯瓦蒂河盆地,

source: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.
reference: 羅馬帝國軍國主義的本質，有助於醫學進步的發展。
hypothesis: 羅馬帝國的軍事性有助於醫學的進步.

source: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.
reference: 奧古斯都皇帝開始招募醫生，這些醫生甚至成立了第一支用於戰後時期的羅馬醫療隊。
hypothesis: 羅馬的醫師團隊也開始在戰爭後使用.

source: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.
reference: 醫生已經知道許多種鎮定劑的存在了，包括從罌粟花籽中提煉出的嗎啡和莨菪籽中的莨菪鹼。
hypothesis: 醫生知道各種鎮靜劑, 包括豆的摩芬和草種子的斯科普拉胺.

source: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.
reference: 他們精通截肢術，將患者從壞疽與因止血帶和動脈夾鉗阻止血液流動所造成的傷害中拯救出來。

reference: 質子帶有正電荷，中子不帶電荷，電子則具有負電荷。
hypothesis: 陽子有正電荷,中子沒有電荷.

source: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.
reference: 檢查傷者之前，你必須先觀察周邊環境，確保自己的安全。
hypothesis: 檢查受害者必須先檢查現場,

source: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.
reference: 靠近傷者時須注意傷者位置和任何出現的警訊。
hypothesis: 您必須注意受害者的位置,

source: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.
reference: 如果你在試圖幫助時受傷，可能只會讓事態變得更糟。
hypothesis: 沒有人能幫助你,

source: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.
reference: 研究發現，抑鬱、恐懼感和災難化可以調解下背部疼痛患者疼痛與失能之間的關係。
hypothesis: 該研究發現抑鬱,恐懼和災難感在腰痛患者的痛楚與殘疾之間的關係中介.

source: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.
reference: 只有災難性的，而非抑鬱和恐懼的作用，才是需要每週定期結構性身體活動訓練的條件。
hypothesis: 只有災難性的影響, 而不是抑鬱和恐懼,

source: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.
reference: 那些進行規律活動的人在對於疼痛的負面感知即慢性疼痛及一般物理性動作所造成的不適感之間的區別，需要更多的協助。
hypothesis: 參與定期運動的人需要更多的支持, 以負面的痛楚感知為準,

source: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.
reference: 視力，或視物的能力，來自視覺系統的感覺器官或眼睛。
hypothesis: 視力或能見能力依賴視力系統,

source: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.
reference: 眼睛包含許多不同構造，各構造的複雜度依其對有機體需求不同而有差別。
hypothesis: 眼睛的結構不同,

source: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.
reference: 不同的結構有不同的功能、對不同的波長敏感、具有不同的敏銳度，還需要不同的處理過程來理解輸入，以及不同的數量達到最佳效率。
hypothesis: 必須要有不同的處理方式才能理解輸入的訊息,

source: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.
reference: 族群指的是在特定地理區域中活動的單一特定物種生物個體組成的群體。
hypothesis: 群體是一個特定的物種在特定的地理區域內的生物群體.

source: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.
reference: 當群體內的所有個體在特定表徵方面都一致之時，便稱為單型性。
hypothesis: 當一個人口中的所有個人都與特定的現象型特徵相似時,

source: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.
reference: 如果個體某項特徵呈現多種差異，即稱為多態性。
hypothesis: 當個體顯示特定特徵的多種變化時,

source: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.
reference: 螞蟻大軍也在不同階段行軍和築巢。
hypothesis: 群也會在不同階段行進和巢.

source: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.
reference: 在游獵階段，行軍蟻會在夜晚行動，白天停下來紮營。
hypothesis: 們在夜間行進,

source: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.
reference: 當食物量減少時，殖民地居民進入了一種遊牧階段。在此階段，殖民地居民建築起暫時性的住所，並且每天變換。
hypothesis: 殖民地開始游牧階段, 當可用食物減少. 在這個階段, 殖民地建立臨時的巢,

source: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.
reference: 這種橫衝直撞的遷徙或行進，每次持續約 17 天。
hypothesis: 這種遊牧狂暴或遊行大約持續17天.

source: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.
reference: 什麼是細胞？細胞一詞來自拉丁語「cella」，意指「小房間」，而最初是由一位使用顯微鏡觀察軟木塞結構的人率先使用這個詞彙。
hypothesis: 細胞是什麼? 這個詞源自拉丁語"cella",

source: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.
reference: 細胞是所有生物的基本單位，所有的生命體都是由一個或多個細胞組成的。
hypothesis: 細胞是所有生物的基本單位,

source: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".
reference: 細胞對於生命的研究是如此基本而重要，事實上，它們常被稱作「生命的積木」。
hypothesis: 細胞是生命研究的基本和關鍵,

source: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.
reference: 神經系統藉由發送神經衝動到全身，保持血液流動且不受干擾，進而維持體內恆定。
hypothesis: 經由神經系統傳送神經衝動,

source: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
reference: 這些神經脈衝以極快的速度傳送到身體各處，協助身體避開潛在威脅。
hypothesis: 這種神經衝動可以很快地傳到全身,

source: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.
reference: 龍捲風與其他猛烈的風暴相比，侵襲的範圍較小，但它們能夠摧毀所有它們所經之處的東西。
hypothesis: 風與其他強暴風暴相比,

source: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
reference: 龍捲風能將樹連根拔起，將建築物上的木板扯掉，並將車輛拋向空中。龍捲風之中最猛烈的 2% 能持續超過 3 小時。
hypothesis: 風會將樹木根拔起,從建築物上撕裂板,將車輛丟到天空.

source: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
reference: 這些怪獸風暴的風速高達每小時 480 公里（每秒 133 公尺；每小時 300 英里）。
hypothesis: 這些巨風風速高達480公里/小時 (133公里/秒; 300英里/小時).

source: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.
reference: 人類幾千年來一直在製造透鏡，並使用它的放大功能。
hypothesis: 人們已經製造並使用放大鏡頭幾千年了.

source: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.
reference: 但第一架真正的望遠鏡是 16 世紀末才在歐洲被製造出來的。
hypothesis: 歐洲的天文學學者

source: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.
reference: 這些望遠鏡使用兩個鏡片，讓遠方的物體顯得更近且更大。
hypothesis: 這種望遠鏡使用兩種鏡頭,

source: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly
reference: 我們將永遠無法擺脫貪婪與自私。合作的本質就是當大多數人受益時，自私的行為在短期總能得到更多利益。
hypothesis: 貪和自私永遠都在我們身邊,

source: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.
reference: 希望多數人終將明白他們長期的最佳選擇是與他人合作。
hypothesis: 希望大部分人會意識到, 他們長期最好的選擇是與他人合作.

source: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.
reference: 許多人夢想著有一天，人類能到達另一個星球，探索其他嶄新的世界；有些人對太陽系外的事物感到好奇；有些則相信外星人或其他形式的生命可能存在於另一顆星球之上。
hypothesis: 有些人想知道外星人或其他生命可能生活在其他植物上.

source: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".
reference: 但是，如果這確實發生過，那麼可能很長一段時間內都不會再發生。天體分散得如此之廣，以至於「比鄰」天體就相隔了數兆英里。
hypothesis: 星星們的分布如此廣泛,

source: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?
reference: 或許未來的某一天，你的曾孫會在站在外星人的世界中，好奇自己的祖先是誰？
hypothesis: 或許有一天, 你的孫子會站在外星人的世界上,

source: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.
reference: 動物由眾多細胞構成。牠們吃東西並在體內消化。多數動物都能移動。
hypothesis: 牠們是有許多細胞的.

source: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).
reference: 只有動物有大腦（然而甚至不是所有動物都有；例如水母就沒有大腦）。
hypothesis: 只有動物有腦 (雖然不是所有動物都有;例如水母沒有腦).

source: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.
reference: 地球各處均能發現動物。牠們在地上挖洞、在海裡游泳、在空中飛翔。
hypothesis: 牠們在地球上都存在.

source: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.
reference: 細胞是生命 (物) 有機體最小的構造單位和功能單位。
hypothesis: 細胞是一個生物體 (物體) 的最小結構和功能單位.

source: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.
reference: 細胞一詞來自拉丁文的 cella，意指小空間。
hypothesis: 這種情況的情況是:

source: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.
reference: 如果你在顯微鏡下觀察生物，你會看到生物是由小方塊或小圓球組成。
hypothesis: 生命的形狀是如何形成的?

source: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.
reference: 英國生物學家羅伯‧虎克透過顯微鏡觀察到軟木塞中的小方塊。
hypothesis: 沒有任何生物學者能發現,

source: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
reference: 它們看起來像一個個房間。他是首位觀察到死亡細胞的人。
hypothesis: 他是第一個觀察死細胞的人.

source: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.
reference: 元素和化合物可以從一種狀態移動到另外一種狀態時，而本質不會產生變化。
hypothesis: 元素和化合物可以從一個狀態轉移到另一個狀態,

source: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.
reference: 氮在氣態之下，仍然與液態氮具有相同的性質。儘管液態密度較高，但兩者分子組成是一樣的。
hypothesis: 氣體的特性與液體相同. 液體狀態較密度,

source: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
reference: 水是另一個例子。水是由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成的。
hypothesis: 氣原子是一個氣原子.

source: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.
reference: 不論是氣體、液體或固體型態，都有相同的分子結構。
hypothesis: 不論是氣體,液體或固體,

source: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
reference: 雖然它的物理狀態可能會改變，但它的化學狀態依舊不變。
hypothesis: 雖然它的物理狀態可能會改變,

source: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.
reference: 時間就在我們周圍，影響著我們所做的一切，但又很難理解。
hypothesis: 時間是我們周圍的東西,

source: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.
reference: 數千年來，宗教、哲學與科學學者都在研究時間。
hypothesis: 科學家們也研究時間.

source: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.
reference: 我們是以從未來到現在、再到過去的一連串事件來感知時間。
hypothesis: 我們體驗時間是從未來,現在,過去的一系列事件.

source: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
reference: 時間也是我們比對事件持續期間（長度）的方式。
hypothesis: 我們如何比較事件的時間 (長度).

source: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
reference: 可透過觀察重複的週期性事件來標記自己的時間流逝。週期性事件指的是定期不斷重複發生的事。
hypothesis: 您可以透過觀察周期性事件的重複,

source: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.
reference: 現在都用電腦來修改照片和影片。
hypothesis: 網路的使用者也會受到影響.

source: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.
reference: 我們可以用電腦做出精緻複雜的動畫，這種動畫越來越常出現在電視與電影上。
hypothesis: 這種動畫在電視和電影中越來越多.

source: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.
reference: 音樂錄製的方式，通常是以精密的電腦處理並進行混音。
hypothesis: 音樂通常是透過複雜的電腦錄音,

source: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.
reference: 十九到二十世紀的很長一段時間，人們都相信紐西蘭的第一批居民是毛利人，他們會獵捕稱為恐鳥的巨鳥。
hypothesis: 據說新西蘭的第一批居民是毛利族,

source: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.
reference: 該理論隨後確立一個觀點，認為毛利人乘坐大艦隊，自玻里尼西亞開始遷徙，然後從莫里奧里人手中奪取紐西蘭，並建立一個農業社會。
hypothesis: 毛利人從波利尼西亞大艦隊中遷徙, 奪取新西蘭,

source: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.
reference: 然而，新的證據指出，莫里奧里人是一個紐西蘭大陸的毛利人族群，他們從紐西蘭遷徙到查塔姆群島，發展出了自己獨特的和平文化。
hypothesis: 莫里奧里族是一個來自新西蘭移民到查坦群島的毛利族群,

source: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.
reference: 查塔姆群島上還有另一個部落，他們是從紐西蘭移民而來的毛利人。
hypothesis: 還有另一個部落在查瑟姆群島,

source: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
reference: 它們稱自己為莫里奧里人，之前發生了一些小衝突，而最終莫里奧里人被抹消了。
hypothesis: 他們稱自己為摩里奧里,

source: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.
reference: 數十年來的長期參與者，可協助我們了解自己的長處和熱情，並坦誠評估自己的困境，甚至是失敗。
hypothesis: 那些已經參與活動幾十年的人幫助我們欣賞我們的強度和熱情,

source: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.
reference: 聆聽個人分享自己、家庭和組織的故事時，我們會聽到寶貴的觀點，更深一層了解過去或對組織文化帶來正負面影響的人物。
hypothesis: 我們也能了解過去與一些影響組織文化的人物.

source: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.
reference: 儘管了解一個人的歷史並不代表了解文化，但這至少可以讓人理解他們在組織的歷史中處在什麼樣的位置上。
hypothesis: 了解自己的歷史並不意味著了解文化,

source: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.
reference: 評估成功和漸漸意識到失敗的同時，個人和全體參與人員將更深入發現組織的價值、使命和驅動力。
hypothesis: 該組織的價值觀,使命和動力更深入地被發現.

source: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.
reference: 在這種情況下，回想起過去的創業行為及成功經驗，可幫助人們樂於接受當地教會的新改變與新方向。
hypothesis: 提醒人們如何做出企業行動, 幫助他們接受新改變,

source: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.
reference: 這種成功故事可以減弱對於改變的恐懼，同時讓人更願意接受未來的改變。
hypothesis: 改變的想法也能讓人們對未來有積極的看法.

source: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.
reference: 聚斂性思考模式是解決問題的技巧，透過結合不同的想法或領域來找出解決方法。
hypothesis: 融合思維模式是解決問題的技巧,

source: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.
reference: 這種思考模式的焦點在於快速、合邏輯和精確，以及辨別事實、重新應用既有的技術、收集資訊。
hypothesis: 這種思維方式的重點是速度,輯和精確,

source: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.
reference: 這種心態最重要的特點就是只有一個正確答案。只考慮兩種解答，即對或不對。
hypothesis: 這種思維方式最重要的一點是:只有一個正確答案.

source: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.
reference: 這種思維方式與特定的科學或標準程序有關。
hypothesis: 這種思維與某些科學或標準程序有關.

source: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.
reference: 這類思考模式的人擅邏輯，他們能記住模式、解決問題、進行科學測試。
hypothesis: 能記錄模式,解決問題,做科研測試.

source: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.
reference: 人類是目前為止最有能力揣摩他人心思的物種。
hypothesis: 人類在讀別人的思想方面是最有才能的物種.

source: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

source: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

hypothesis: 如果他失去了車匙,

reference: 磁振造影 (MRI) 的基礎是一種稱為核磁共振 (NMR) 的物理現象，該現像是由菲利克斯‧布洛赫（史丹佛大學）和愛德華‧珀塞爾（哈佛大學）在 1930 年代發現的。
hypothesis: 磁共振是一個物理現象, 它是1930年代由菲利克斯·布洛克 (他在斯坦福大學工作) 和愛德華·普爾塞爾 (在哈佛大學) 發現的.

source: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

hypothesis: 原子發出微小的無線訊號.

reference: 1970 年，研究科學家雷蒙德．達馬迪安醫生發現了使用磁振造影作為醫療診斷工具的原理。

source: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.
reference: 四年後獲得一項專利，這是世界上第一個 MRI 領域的專利。

source: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.
reference: 1977 年，達馬迪安醫生完成建造第一台「全身性」磁振造影掃描儀，他將之稱為「不屈者」。
hypothesis: 達馬迪安博士在1977年完成了第一台全身MRI掃描器的建造,

source: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

source: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

source: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

source: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
reference: 我們永遠不會去改造汽車、在後院蓋一座噴水池、去祕魯考察古代遺跡，或是翻修鄰居的房子。

source: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.
reference: 感謝連接到歐洲的海底光纖電纜和衛星寬頻，格陵蘭島上的網際網路非常發達，93% 人口皆能上網。
hypothesis: 格陵蘭有93%的人口能上網, 這項計畫將在今年的第二季度推動.

source: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.
reference: 旅館或主人（如果住在民宿或私人住宅）應能提供 WiFi 或可上網電腦，且所有社區皆有網咖或部分提供 WiFi 的地點。

reference: 如上所述，雖然美國仍可接受「愛斯基摩人」一詞，但許多非美裔的北極地區人民，尤其是加拿大人，卻視之為貶義。

source: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.
reference: 在加拿大的格陵蘭原住民自稱為因紐特人，在格陵蘭則自稱為「Kalaalleq」（複數為 Kalaallit），意指「格陵蘭人」。

source: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.
reference: 猶地亞山的古城擁有長達數千年的迷人歷史。
hypothesis: 這座古城在猶太山脈上有著幾千年的歷史.

source: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.
reference: 該城市是三種一神教──猶太教、基督教和伊斯蘭教的聖地，也是精神、宗教和文化的中心。
hypothesis: 這座城市是三個單神教派 - 猶太教,基督教和伊斯蘭教的聖地,

source: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.
reference: 由於宗教上的重要性，特別是舊城區的許多遺址，耶路撒冷成為以色列的主要觀光景點之一。
hypothesis: 耶路撒冷是以色列的主要旅遊目的地之一.

source: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
reference: 耶路撒冷擁有許多歷史、考古和文化景點，以及充滿活力且人潮擁擠的購物中心、咖啡廳和餐廳。
hypothesis: 耶路撒冷有許多歷史,考古和文化遺跡,

source: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.
reference: 厄瓜多要求古巴公民在經國際機場或入境關口進入厄瓜多之前，必須收到邀請函。
hypothesis: 厄瓜多爾要求古巴公民在通過國際機場或邊境入境點進入厄瓜多爾之前收到邀請函.

source: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.
reference: 此信必須經厄瓜多外交部批准，並符合相關要求。
hypothesis: 這封信必須由厄瓜多爾外交部合法化,

source: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.
reference: 這些要求是為了讓兩國間的遷徙活動更井然有序。
hypothesis: 兩國之間的移民流量有序.

source: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.
reference: 持有美國綠卡的古巴公民應前往厄瓜多領事館，獲得這些條件的豁免權。
hypothesis: 美國綠卡持有者應前往厄瓜多爾領事館,

source: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.
reference: 從旅行日期開始計算，你的護照必須擁有 6 個月以上有效期限。此外還需要來回票或前往他地機票，證明你的停留時間。
hypothesis: 您的護照必須在您的旅行日期後至少有效6個月.

source: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.
reference: 越多人的旅行團價格越便宜，所以若是單獨或與一名朋友外出旅行，可以與其他人結伴組成四到六人的團體，以降低個人單價。
hypothesis: 旅行便宜於大團體, 所以如果你單獨或只帶一個朋友,

source: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.
reference: 但您不需要太擔心，因為通常都會有許多旅客四處詢問加入旅行團。
hypothesis: 沒有任何人能在這裏找到任何可靠的旅遊.

source: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
reference: 這似乎更像是某種騙人以為他們必須付更多錢的招數。
hypothesis: 似乎更像是騙人相信他們必須付更多.

source: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.
reference: 矗立在馬丘比丘北側的陡峭尖山，經常成為許多馬丘比丘遺址照片的背景。
hypothesis: 這座的山通常是遺跡的背景.

source: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.
reference: 它由下仰望看起來有些嚇人，坡度陡峭難以攀登。但是大部分體力正常的人應該可以在45分鐘內登頂。
hypothesis: 這是一段坡,難以登的路,

source: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.
reference: 大部分的步道都鋪設石階，地勢陡峭的路段則裝上鋼纜作為扶手。
hypothesis: 石頭階段在大部分路線上都被鋪設,

source: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.
reference: 也就是說，要有喘不過氣的心理準備，也要特別小心較陡的部份，尤其是潮濕的時候，因為這可能迅速使情況變得危險。
hypothesis: 尤其是當水時, 這可能很危險.

source: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.
reference: 接近頂端的地方有個必須穿越的小洞穴，它的高度很低且擠出洞有點難度。
hypothesis: 這裡有個小洞穴,

source: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.
reference: 欣賞加拉巴哥美景和野生動植物的最佳方式就是乘船，一如查爾斯‧達爾文在 1835 年的作法。
hypothesis: 查爾斯達爾文在1835年就這樣乘船去觀光加拉帕戈斯群島的景點和野生動物.

source: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.
reference: 超過 60 艘遊輪往返加拉巴哥群島的水域，搭載乘客數從 8 名到 100 名不等。
hypothesis: 超過60艘遊船在加拉帕戈斯海域航行,

source: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).
reference: 大多數遊客很早就提前訂位（旺季的船票通常一位難求）。
hypothesis: 沒有任何地方可以預訂.

source: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.
reference: 確保幫您預訂的旅行社是加拉巴哥群島的專家，並擁有對各種船隻的廣泛知識。
hypothesis: 確保您預訂的代理人是加拉帕戈斯專家,

source: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.
reference: 這將確保您的特定興趣和/或限制會與最適合它們的船隻相符。
hypothesis: 這樣才能確保您的特殊興趣和/或限制與最適合他們的船隻相匹配.

source: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.
reference: 在西班牙人於 16 世紀抵達智利前，其北部受印加帝國統治，中部及南部則居住著原住民阿勞卡尼亞人（馬普切人）。
hypothesis: 在西班牙人到來前, 智利北部都在印加人的統治之下,

source: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.
reference: 馬普切人也是最後一群獨立的美洲原住民團體之一，他們直到智利獨立後，才完全被納入西班牙語的治理。
hypothesis: 普什族也是最後一批獨立的美國原住民群體之一,

source: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.
reference: 雖然智利在 1810 年即宣佈獨立（當時正值拿破侖戰爭，西班牙有好幾年都沒有正常運作的中央政府），但直到 1818 年才擊敗西班牙，取得決定性的勝利。
hypothesis: 雖然智利在1810年宣布獨立 (在拿破戰爭中, 兩年來西班牙沒有運作的中央政府), 但直到1818年才取得決定性勝利.

source: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti
reference: 多明尼加共和國（西班牙文：República Dominicana）是一個加勒比海國家，和西邊的海地共同位於伊斯帕尼奧拉島上。
hypothesis: 多明尼加共和國 (西班牙語: República Dominicana) 是一個加勒比海國家,佔據西班牙島的東半部,

source: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.
reference: 除了白色沙灘和山岳景觀，這個國家也是美洲最古老的歐式城市的所在地，就是現在是聖多明哥的一部份。
hypothesis: 歐洲最古老的城市, 現在是聖多明哥的一部分.

source: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.
reference: 此島最初的居民為泰諾人與加勒比人。加勒比人說的是阿拉瓦語系，在約公元前一萬年來到此地。
hypothesis: 島上最初居住的是泰諾人和加里伯人.

source: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors
reference: 在歐洲探險家抵達後的短短幾年內，塔伊諾城的人口遭到西班牙征服者大幅地削減。
hypothesis: 歐洲探險家來到後的幾年內,

source: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
reference: 根據《弗雷·巴托洛梅·德拉斯·卡薩斯》（西印度專著），在 1492 年至 1498 年間，西班牙征服者約殺了 100,000 名泰諾人。
hypothesis: 根據巴特羅梅德拉斯卡薩斯 (巴特羅梅德拉斯卡薩斯) 的說法,

source: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.
reference: Jardín de la Unión，是一座 17 世紀修道院修建來作為中庭使用的空間，而聖地牙哥聖殿 (Templo de san Diego) 是該修道院碩果僅存的建築。
hypothesis: 這座空間是17世紀修道院的大堂,

source: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.
reference: 如今此空間被當作中央廣場，不論日夜都十分熱鬧。
hypothesis: 這座城市的中心廣場,

source: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.
reference: 花園周圍有幾間餐廳，下午和晚上通常在中央涼亭有免費演奏會。
hypothesis: 廣場裡有許多餐廳, 午後和晚上通常在中央的陽台上舉辦免費音樂會.

source: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.
reference: Callejon del Beso（親吻小巷）。古老愛情傳說的發源地，因兩邊陽台中間間距只有 69 公分。
hypothesis: 這裡有兩座只有69公分的陽台,

source: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.
reference: 花幾枚硬幣，就會有小孩說故事給你聽。
hypothesis: 孩子們會為你講故事.

source: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.
reference: 寶雲島是熱門的一日遊或週末郊遊的地點，可進行划皮艇、健行、購物和餐飲等活動。
hypothesis: 波恩島是一個熱門的一日遊或週末遊覽,

source: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.
reference: 這個道地社區位於溫哥華附近的豪灣，乘坐從溫哥華市中心固蘭湖島出發的定時水上計程車就能輕鬆抵達。
hypothesis: 這座真實的社區位於溫哥華郊外的霍威海,

source: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.
reference: 對那些喜歡戶外活動的人來說，一定要到海天走廊旅行。
hypothesis: 那些喜歡戶外活動的人,

source: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.
reference: 託 2010 冬季奧運的福，距離溫哥華車程 1.5 小時的惠斯勒又貴又出名。
hypothesis: 威斯勒 (距離溫哥華 1.5 小時車程) 很貴,

source: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.
reference: 冬季可享受北美洲最棒的滑雪場地，夏季則可體驗最正統的登山自行車。
hypothesis: 冬天可以享受北美最好的滑雪,

source: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.
reference: 許可證必須事先預訂。你必須擁有許可證才能在錫雷納過夜。
hypothesis: 您必須提前預訂許可證,

source: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.
reference: 只有西雷納林區管理站提供露營地以外的合宿房與熱食。拉萊歐那、聖佩德里羅和洛斯帕托斯只提供露營地，不提供食物。
hypothesis: 只有西雷娜和洛斯帕托斯提供露營,沒有食物服務.

source: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards
reference: 您可能可以直接從希門尼斯港的公園管理處預定通行證，但他們不收信用卡。
hypothesis: 您可以直接在Puerto Jiménez的游客站獲得停車許可,

source: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.
reference: 公園管理處（哥斯大黎加環境能源部）只簽發預計抵達時間在一個月內的許可證。
hypothesis: 公園服務 (MINAE) 沒有在預期到來時間前發出超過一個月的公園許可.

reference: El Sol 網咖提供預約服務，費用為美金 $30，或一日票 $10；更多訊息請見科爾科瓦杜國家公園相關頁面。

source: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.
reference: 庫克群島是一個與紐西蘭自由結盟的島國，位於南太平洋中部的玻里尼西亞。
hypothesis: 科克群島是與新西蘭自由聯盟的島國,

source: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.
reference: 這是由 15 座島嶼組成的群島，遍佈在 220 萬平方公里的海上。
hypothesis: 該國的海域面積超過2200萬平方公里,

source: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".
reference: 因為群島跟夏威夷同時區，所以有時又被稱為「南半球夏威夷」。
hypothesis: 島的時間區與夏威夷相同,

source: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.
reference: 雖然面積較小，但此處會讓一些年長旅客想起尚未成為美國一州、大型觀光飯店與其他開發案還沒進駐的夏威夷。
hypothesis: 儘管它較小, 但也讓一些老年人想起夏威夷在沒有所有大型旅遊酒店和其他發展的國家之前的狀況.

source: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.
reference: 庫克群島沒有任何城市，而是由十五個不同島嶼組成。主要島嶼是拉羅湯加島及艾圖塔基島。
hypothesis: 庫克群島沒有任何城市,

source: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.
reference: 在今日的已開發國家，提供豪華的 B&B 服務已經提升為一種藝術。
hypothesis: 提供豪華的早餐和睡覺已成為一種藝術形式.

source: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.
reference: 在高端市場中，民宿業者主要的競爭項目明顯為兩大項：寢具用品和早餐。
hypothesis: 酒店的價格主要是兩大主要商品:床上衣和早餐.

source: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.
reference: 因此，在最頂級的這類場所容易找到最奢華的寢具，也許是手工被單或骨董床。
hypothesis: 沒有人會發現最奢華的床單,

source: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.
reference: 早餐可能包含當地的季節性美食或民宿主人的特製佳餚。
hypothesis: 提供當地季節的美味或主人的特色菜.

source: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.
reference: 那可能是一棟具歷史意義的老建築，擁有古董家具、修剪整齊的庭園和游泳池。
hypothesis: 還有許多其他地方的建築物,

source: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.
reference: 坐上自己的汽車，展開一場漫長的公路之旅，這種簡單的旅行方式本身就非常有吸引力。
hypothesis: 沒有任何問題.

source: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.
reference: 與大型車輛不同，你很可能已經對於駕駛自己的車輛很熟悉，也了解它的侷限。
hypothesis: 你可能已經熟悉駕駛你的車,

source: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.
reference: 在私人土地或任何大小的城鎮搭起帳棚，都很容易引起不必要的注意。
hypothesis: 沒有人能吸引你去看.

source: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".
reference: 簡而言之，開車是進行公路旅行的好方式，但那本身鮮少是一種「露營」方式。
hypothesis: 沒有任何地方可以使用車.

source: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.
reference: 如果您有一輛座椅能放平的大型迷你廂型車、休旅車、轎車或是旅行車，便能從事汽車露營。
hypothesis: 您可以在車上露營,

source: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
reference: 有些旅館保留了屬於蒸氣鐵路與遠洋郵輪黃金時代的遺跡，來自於二戰前，19 世紀或 20 世紀初。
hypothesis: 部分酒店的歷史來自於蒸汽鐵路和海上航班的黃金時代,

source: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.
reference: 這些飯店是當時富豪名流的下榻之處，通常飯店裡會提供高級的餐點和夜生活。
hypothesis: 這裡的飯店是當代富人和名人住宿的地方,

source: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.
reference: 過時的五金配件、沒有新型家電設施，以及特有的優雅年代感，都是這種飯店的特色。
hypothesis: 沒有最新的設施, 還有某種優雅的老化,

source: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.
reference: 儘管這類旅館大多是私有的，但有時也會接待來訪的國家元首和其他達官顯貴。
hypothesis: 總統的部落格寫道:"我們必須在這些國家做出努力,

source: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.
reference: 手頭闊綽的旅客可能會考慮來趟環遊世界之旅，並在這些旅館中的幾間留宿。
hypothesis: 旅行者可能會想到環球飛機,

source: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.
reference: 住宿交換網站是一個能將遊客和他們欲前往的城市當地人連結起來的組織。
hypothesis: 接待交流網絡是一個組織,

source: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
reference: 加入這樣的網路通常只需要填寫線上表格即可；雖然有些網路會提供或需要額外的驗證。
hypothesis: 該網際網路的使用者通常只需要填寫網際網路表格,

source: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
reference: 可供選擇的房東列表會以紙本或線上方式提供，偶爾還會附有其他旅客留下的推薦和評價。
hypothesis: 提供提供提供服務的旅客名單,

source: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
reference: 沙發衝浪於 2004 年 1 月成立，起因是電腦程式設計師凱西‧芬頓找到廉價班機飛往冰島，卻沒地方住。
hypothesis: 網路上有許多人使用網路,

source: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
reference: 他寄電郵給當地大學的學生，接著收到大量免費住宿的邀請。
hypothesis: 他發送電子郵件給當地大學的學生,

source: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
reference: 青年旅社的主要客群是年輕人，典型房客是 20 來歲的年輕人，但也常會在那裡看到年紀較大的旅客。
hypothesis: 旅館主要是為年輕人服務, 典型的客人是20歲以上的旅客,

source: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
reference: 帶著小孩的家庭極為少見，但有些青年旅館確實會允許他們入住私人套房。
hypothesis: 但有些民宿允許他們在私房.

source: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
reference: 中國的北京市將主辦 2022 年的冬季奧林匹克運動會，這將使北京成為第一座主辦過夏季與冬季奧運的城市。
hypothesis: 首次舉辦夏季和冬季奧運會.

source: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
reference: 北京將主辦開幕及閉幕式，還有室內冰上項目。
hypothesis: 還有冰場活動.

source: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
reference: 其他滑雪活動將在張家口的太子城滑雪區進行，距離北京約 220 公里（140 英里）。
hypothesis: 還有其他滑雪活動將在距離北京約220公里 (140英里) 的張家口的台芝慶滑雪場舉行.

source: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
reference: 從十一月底到五月中，大多數寺廟都會舉辦年度慶典，確切日期則依每間寺廟的年度行事曆而定。
hypothesis: 很多寺廟都舉辦年慶, 始於11月底至5月中旬,

source: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
reference: 大部分的廟宇慶典都是為了慶祝寺廟週年、主祀神祉的生日、或其他與該廟宇相關的重要活動。
hypothesis: 很多寺廟節日都是為了慶祝寺廟的週年慶,主持神的生日或任何與寺廟相關的重大事件.

source: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
reference: 去喀拉拉邦看寺廟慶典挺有意思的，他們定期會有佩戴裝飾的大象遊行、寺廟樂團及其他慶典。
hypothesis: 林的聖誕節是一個很有趣的節日,

source: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
reference: 世界博覽會（亦稱萬國博覽會，或簡稱世博會）是一個大型的國際藝術與科學展覽活動。
hypothesis: 世界博覽會 (通常稱為世界博覽會,或簡稱博覽會) 是大型國際藝術與科學節.

source: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
reference: 參與國會在各自的國家館設置藝術或教育展，用以展示世界議題或該國的文化與歷史。
hypothesis: 參加國家在國家展廳展示藝術與教育,

source: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
reference: 世界園藝博覽會是一種專業性活動，專門展示花卉布置、植物園和其他有關植物的所有事物。
hypothesis: 展覽會的目的是展示植物,植物園及其他植物相關的產品.

source: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
reference: 儘管理論上可以年年舉辦（只要辦在不同國家/地區就好了），實際上則不然。
hypothesis: 儘管理論上可以每年舉辦 (只要在不同國家舉辦),

source: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
reference: 這些活動通常會持續 3 至 6 個月，且舉辦場地不會小於 50 公頃。
hypothesis: 該活動通常持續三至六個月, 舉辦在不小於50公頃的地點.

source: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
reference: 多年來存在許多不同的底片格式。標準的 35 公釐底片 (36×24 公釐負片) 是最常見的。
hypothesis: 影片的不同格式也多年來一直在使用.

source: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
reference: 用完時，補充起來通常相當簡單，解析度堪可比擬現代的數位單眼相機。
hypothesis: 這樣的光線也能與現在的 DSLR 相當相當.

source: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
reference: 有些中片幅底片相機使用 6 公分乘 6 公分的格式，更準確地說是 56 毫米乘 56 毫米負片。
hypothesis: 有些中型影像攝影機使用6x6公分格式,

source: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
reference: 這種格式的解析度幾乎是 35 釐米負片的四倍（3136 平方釐米相對於 864 平方釐米）。
hypothesis: 這樣的分辨率將近是35毫米負的四倍 (3136毫米2對 864毫米).

source: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
reference: 野生動物對攝影師來說可能是最有挑戰性的主題，並且需要結合運氣、耐心、經驗和良好的器材。
hypothesis: 野生動物是攝影師最難以拍攝的物品之一,

source: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
reference: 人們經常認為野生動物攝影沒什麼獨特之處，但就和一般攝影作品一樣，一張照片就能包含千言萬語。
hypothesis: 照片價值千個字,

source: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
reference: 野生動物攝影通常需要使用長焦鏡頭，而拍攝一群鳥類或一隻小型動物則需要其他鏡頭。
hypothesis: 野生動物攝影通常需要長遠的遠光鏡頭,

source: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
reference: 許多珍稀的動物很難發現，且有些公園可能會有限制商業化拍攝的規定。
hypothesis: 沒有任何地方可以拍攝這些動物.

source: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
reference: 野生動物可能很怕生或很有攻擊性，而生存環境可能很冷、很熱或很不友善。
hypothesis: 野生動物可能會害羞或是.

source: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
reference: 全世界有五千多種語言，其中超過二十種最少都有五千萬的使用者。
hypothesis: 還有超過20種語言,

source: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
reference: 此外，書面字詞通常比口語字詞容易理解，尤其是傳達地址時，因為地址通常很難清楚地發音。
hypothesis: 寫出來的文字通常比說出來的文字更容易理解.

source: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
reference: 很多國家全國上下都能說流利的英語，而能稍微理解英語的國家更多，特別是這些國家的年輕人。
hypothesis: 很多國家完全掌握英语,

source: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
reference: 想像一下，在多倫多一間餐廳裡，各有一名曼徹斯特人、波士頓人、牙買加人和雪梨人圍坐在一張桌子吃晚餐。
hypothesis: 想象一下, 如果你們願意,

source: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
reference: 他們以獨特口音和地方俚語說著自己家鄉的故事，逗彼此開心。
hypothesis: 他們在各自的口音和當地語中分享他們家鄉的故事.

source: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
reference: 在超市購買食物通常是餵飽自己最便宜的途徑。但若沒有烹飪的機會，就只能選擇現成的熟食了。
hypothesis: 購買超市的食物通常是最便宜的食物方式.

source: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
reference: 越來越多超市開始提供更多樣化的即食品，部分超市甚至提供微波爐或其他設備以食物加熱。
hypothesis: 超市的成品越來越多. 有些甚至提供微波烤箱或其他方式加熱食物.

source: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
reference: 在某些國家或某些類型的商店中，至少會有一間附設餐廳，通常是價格實惠且較隨意的餐廳。
hypothesis: 還有許多其他國家或商店至少有一家餐廳,

source: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
reference: 準備一份保單影本以及保險公司的聯絡資料並隨身攜帶。
hypothesis: 請您自行製作保險和保險公司聯絡方式的副本,

source: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
reference: 上面必須記有保險公司的電子郵件地址和國際電話號碼，以便諮詢/授權和申請理賠。
hypothesis: 他們需要提供保險公司的電子郵件地址和國際電話號碼,

source: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
reference: 在您的行李中及線上各保存一份副本（以電子郵件連同附件傳送給自己，或儲存在「雲端」）。
hypothesis: 請把另一份電子書放在行李箱裡,

source: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
reference: 若攜帶筆電或平板電腦旅行，請在其記憶體或光碟中儲存備份（在沒有網際網路時仍可存取）。
hypothesis: 如果您帶著筆電或平板電腦旅行,

source: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
reference: 並將保單／聯絡人複本提供給旅伴及願意協助的家中親友。
hypothesis: 請給出國的同行,親戚或朋友提供政策/聯絡表.

source: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
reference: 駝鹿（常稱為麋鹿）並非天生就具有攻擊性，但遭受威脅時會保護自己。
hypothesis: 魚 (也稱) 沒有本性侵略性,

source: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
reference: 如果人們認為駝鹿不太可能造成危險，就可能會靠得太近而身處風險之中。
hypothesis: 魚可能會被捕,

source: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
reference: 飲用酒精性飲料要適量。酒精對每個人的影響程度不同，因此知道自己的酒量非常重要。
hypothesis: 酒精飲料要適度飲用.酒精對每個人都不一樣,

source: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
reference: 過量飲酒造成的長期健康問題可能包括肝臟受損，甚或失明與死亡。飲用非法釀造的酒也會增加潛在危險。
hypothesis: 飲酒可能會造成長期的健康後果, 包括肝臟受傷,甚至失明和死亡.

source: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
reference: 非法烈酒可能含有各種危險的雜質，包括甲醇，即使是少量都有可能導致失明或死亡。
hypothesis: 非法酒精可能含有各種危險的污染物,

source: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
reference: 在外國眼鏡可能較為便宜，尤其是在勞動成本低廉的低收入國家。
hypothesis: 眼鏡在外國可能會更便宜,

source: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
reference: 可以在出國前檢查一下眼睛，再帶著處方去其他國家，保險有給付的話特別推薦這個做法。
hypothesis: 請考慮在家裡進行眼科檢查, 尤其是如果保險承擔,

source: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
reference: 在此等地區所提供的高級名牌眼鏡框可能會有兩個問題；有些可能是仿冒品，而真正的進口名牌商品售價可能比原產地更昂貴。
hypothesis: 其他國家的高級品牌可能會有兩個問題:有些可能是假版,

source: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
reference: 咖啡是全球貿易量數一數二大的商品，你在住家附近也許就能找到各式各樣的咖啡。
hypothesis: 咖啡是世界上最多的商品之一,

source: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
reference: 不過，全世界有許多大異其趣的咖啡飲用方式都值得體驗。
hypothesis: 咖啡是最重要的,

source: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
reference: 溪降（canyoning 或 canyoneering ）是前往峽谷底部的運動，峽谷底可能是乾涸或滿水狀態。
hypothesis: 山登 (或: canyoneering) 是指進入山的底部,

source: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
reference: 溪降結合了游泳、攀爬和跳躍等要素，但訓練或身體狀態的入門要求相對較低（例如相較於攀岩、水肺潛水或高山滑雪）。
hypothesis: 山涉水,登和跳跳的元素, 但需要相對少的訓練或體力來開始 (比如岩,潛水或高山滑雪).

source: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
reference: 健行是一種在自然環境中（通常是在健行步道上）行走的戶外活動。
hypothesis: 徒步旅行是一項戶外活動,

source: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
reference: 單日健行為一英里以下或更長距離的單日行程。
hypothesis: 沒有任何可能造成的傷害.

source: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
reference: 輕鬆小徑的一日健行，不必做太多準備，任何體能適中的人都能享受這樣的健行。
hypothesis: 任何適度健身的人都能享受這些活動.

source: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
reference: 帶著幼兒的家庭可能需要更多準備，不過就算是帶著嬰兒或是學齡前兒童，戶外一日遊也可以簡單達成。
hypothesis: 還有許多小孩的家庭需要更多的準備,

source: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
reference: 國際上有近兩百個跑步旅遊組織。這些組織大多數獨立運作。
hypothesis: 該組織的經營者為何不需要提供旅遊服務?

source: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
reference: Go Running Tours 接續 Global Running Tours 成立，在四大洲串連了數十個觀光路跑供應商。
hypothesis: 還有許多其他國家的觀光業者也參與.

source: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
reference: 他們的總部位於巴塞隆納的 Running Tours Barcelona 和哥本哈根的 Running Copenhagen，位於布拉格的 Running Tours Prague 等各地組織也很快就加入他們。
hypothesis: 經由巴塞隆納的跑步之旅巴塞隆納和哥本哈根的跑步之旅哥本哈根,

source: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

hypothesis: 來自其他地區的居民通常把家庭友好作為他們搬到這裏的主要原因,

reference: 過去 20 年，夏洛特上城區適合兒童去的地方數量倍增。
hypothesis: 在過去20年中, 查羅特市區的兒童友好選擇數量已呈指數增長.

source: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.
reference: 一般而言夏洛特市的家庭通常不會使用計程車，但在特定情況下使用計程車十分方便。
hypothesis: 儘管在某些情況下可以提供一些服務.

source: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
reference: 超過兩名乘客需支付額外的費用，所以這個做法可能會多花不必要的錢。
hypothesis: 這種選擇可能比必要更昂貴.

source: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.
reference: 圍繞南極的南極洲是地球上最冷的地方。
hypothesis: 非洲南極是地球上最冷的地方,

source: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.
reference: 遊客來訪的花費頗高、需要體力、只能在 夏季 11 月到 2 月間進行，且範圍多限制在半島、島嶼和羅斯海。
hypothesis: 旅遊旅遊很昂貴,需要體力健,只能在夏季11月至2月期間進行,

source: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.
reference: 在夏天，有數千名人員在近五十座基地內（多數位於那些地區）生活；少數人會留下過冬。
hypothesis: 只有少數人過冬, 只有少數人在冬季住宿.

source: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.
reference: 南極洲內陸是一片荒蕪的高原，上面覆蓋著 2-3 公里厚的冰層。
hypothesis: 內陸南極是一片荒涼的高原,

source: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
reference: 專家偶爾會搭機進入南極州內陸登山，或前往位在南極點的大型基地。
hypothesis: 專家的飛行團隊偶爾會前往內陸,登山或到達極地,

source: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.
reference: 南極橫貫公路是一條一千六百公里長的道路，從羅斯海的麥克默多站一路通到南極。
hypothesis: 羅斯海馬達克馬多站到北極的路線長達1600公里.

source: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.
reference: 它是壓實的雪地，裂縫也經過填補，有旗幟作為記號。只有駕駛專用拖拉機才能行駛，後方拖著載了燃油與物資的雪橇。
hypothesis: 只有專門的拖拉機才能穿過, 拖帶著燃料和物資.

source: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
reference: 它們不太靈活，所以路徑必須沿著橫貫南極山脈繞著長長的彎路才能抵達高原上方。
hypothesis: 這樣的山脈不太靈活,

source: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.
reference: 冬天最常見的意外成因是溼滑的馬路、人行道、及最容易發生危險的階梯。
hypothesis: 冬季最常發生事故的原因是滑路,路面 (人行道) 尤其是步道.

source: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.
reference: 你至少需要合適的鞋底。夏季鞋類在冰面和雪地上通常會打滑，某些冬季靴款甚至也不足以止滑。
hypothesis: 冬季鞋子也會很滑, 冬季鞋子也會很滑.

source: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.
reference: 鞋底紋路應當夠深，至少達 5 公釐（1/5 英寸），且材質在冷天中仍保持柔軟。
hypothesis: 該模組應足夠深, 5 毫米或以上,

source: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.
reference: 有些靴子帶有鞋釘，也有專為溼滑環境而設、適用於多數鞋子與靴子的拆卸式鞋釘，可僅裝配在鞋跟，或在鞋跟、鞋底皆裝。
hypothesis: 鞋子的鞋子和鞋底都能搭配.

source: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
reference: 鞋跟應低且寬。道路或步道上常灑上沙子、碎石或鹽（氯化鈣），以增加摩擦力。
hypothesis: 腳跟應該低而寬. 沙子,石或 (化物) 常被散在道路或路徑上,

source: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.
reference: 雪崩並非異常現象；陡峭斜坡能累積的雪量有限，多餘的積雪會掉下形成雪崩。
hypothesis: 積雪並不是異常; 坡的速度也很慢,

source: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.
reference: 問題是雪有黏性，因此需要一些契機才會滑落，而有些許的雪滑落後，才有可能帶動其他的雪塊崩落。
hypothesis: 雪的降落可能是其他雪的降落事件的起因.

source: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
reference: 原初的觸發事件有時是太陽使雪升溫，有時是下了更多雪，有時是其它自然事件，但更常是人為。
hypothesis: 有時是太陽加溫雪, 有時是更多的雪,

source: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.
reference: 龍捲風是一個極低氣壓的旋轉空氣柱，它把周圍的空氣往內、往上吸。
hypothesis: 風是一個旋轉的低壓空氣柱,

source: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.
reference: 它們會產生強風（通常為 100-200 英里/小時），且可以將重物抬舉至空中，並隨著龍捲風移動。
hypothesis: 風可能會造成高風速 (通常是每小時100至200英里),

source: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.
reference: 它們開始時是從風暴雲中下降造成的漏斗，而後在接觸地面時成為「龍捲風」。
hypothesis: 風會從暴風雨雲中降落,

source: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.
reference: 個人 VPN（虛擬私人網路）供應商為規避政治審查和商業 IP 地理過濾的極佳管道。
hypothesis: 提供個人VPN (虛擬私人網路) 提供者是避政治審查和商業IP地理波的好方法.

source: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.
reference: 它們優於網路代理伺服器的理由有幾個：它們能重新導向所有網路流量，而非只有 http 的流量。
hypothesis: 他們是優於網路代理程序的,

source: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.
reference: 他們通常會提供更高的頻寬與更好的服務品質，且經過加密，因此較難被監控。
hypothesis: 網路上使用者通常會使用網路的網路,

source: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
reference: 媒體公司經常的在此舉的目的上說謊，聲稱這是為了「防止盜版」。
hypothesis: 媒體公司常常說謊,

source: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.
reference: 實際上，區域碼完全無法防止盜版；逐位元複製的光碟可以在任何設備上，如同原版般正常播放。
hypothesis: 網路上的網路也會讓人覺得很難使用.

source: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.
reference: 實際目的是讓公司更能掌控他們的市場；一切都是為了賺錢。
hypothesis: 實際目的是讓這些公司更能控制他們的市場,

source: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.
reference: 由於通話是透過網際網路傳訊的，不需要用到住處或到訪處的電話公司。
hypothesis: 您的電話可能會被轉移到網路上,

source: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.
reference: 無需擁有居住社區的當地電話號碼；你可以在阿拉斯加州奇金野外取得衛星網際網路連線，然後選擇一組電話號碼，宣稱你人在陽光普照的亞利桑那州。
hypothesis: 您可以在阿拉斯加的Chicken的野生地區獲得衛星網路連線,

source: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
reference: 常見的情況是必須購買不同的國際電話號碼，才能接到 PSTN 電話。對打電話給你的人而言，號碼來自哪裡確實有差別。
hypothesis: 您必須買一個全球號碼, 讓PSTN電話可以打電話給您.

source: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.
reference: 即時文本翻譯應用程式 – 可自動將整段文本從一種語言翻譯成另一種語言的應用程式。
hypothesis: 能夠自動從一個語言翻譯整個文本段的應用程式.

source: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.
reference: 有些這種類型的應用程式甚至可翻譯現實世界中標誌或其他物件上的外文，用戶只要把智慧型手機對準這些物件。
hypothesis: 該類別的某些應用程式甚至可以翻譯使用手機指向這些物體的外語文字.

source: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.
reference: 翻譯引擎已有巨大的改進，現在通常提供或多或少正確的翻譯（和更少的胡言亂語），但因為翻譯結果仍可能完全是錯誤的，應對其持有一些小心謹慎的態度。
hypothesis: 翻譯引擎的改進顯著, 現在通常提供多或少正確的翻譯 (更少有語),

source: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.
reference: 此類別中最著名的應用程式之一是 Google 翻譯，它可以在下載所需的語言資料後，進行離線翻譯。
hypothesis: 提供了非線上翻譯的功能,

source: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.
reference: 出國時，在智慧型手機上使用 GPS 導航應用程式，可能是最簡單且最便利的導航方式。
hypothesis: 透過智能手機使用GPS導航應用程式,

source: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.
reference: 相較於購買 GPS 的新地圖或獨立的 GPS 裝置，向租車公司租用新地圖較省錢。
hypothesis: 還是租車公司租一台. 這樣的價格可能會讓你省錢,

source: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.
reference: 如果你的手機沒有數據連線，或者已經超出連線範圍，GPS 導航的表現可能會受到限制或無法使用。
hypothesis: 如果您的手機沒有數據連接, 或是無法接觸,

source: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.
reference: 每一間雜貨店都有販售預付電話卡，種類多到不知如何選擇，這些電話卡可以用於付費電話或普通的電話。
hypothesis: 沒有任何地方可以使用預付電話卡,

source: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.
reference: 雖然大部分的預付卡都可以打電話到任何國家，但某些預付卡會提供特定幾個國家優惠通話費率。
hypothesis: 該卡片的使用方式也很好,

source: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.
reference: 通常可以透過撥打一支免付費電話號碼來取得這些服務，大多數手機可以免費撥打該電話號碼。
hypothesis: 該網站的使用者通常可以使用免費電話號碼,

source: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.
reference: 針對一般攝影的規範也適用於錄影，甚至有更多的規定。
hypothesis: 影片錄製也可能更為嚴格.

source: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.
reference: 如果連拍張照片都不被允許，那麼就更不要想要將它錄成影片了。
hypothesis: 沒有任何影片可以拍攝.

source: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.
reference: 若要使用無人機，請事先仔細確認可以拍攝什麼以及是否需要什麼許可或額外授權。
hypothesis: 請提前確認您有什麼許可或需要什麼許可.

source: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
reference: 將無人機開到機場附近或飛過人群上方，就算不違反所在地法律，此舉幾乎都是壞主意。
hypothesis: 飛機在機場附近或在人群上空,

source: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.
reference: 如今，很少人會不先經過搜尋或比價，就直接向航空公司訂機票旅行。
hypothesis: 沒有先搜尋和比較價格,

source: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.
reference: 有時在不同的資料彙集網站上，同一班機的價差很大，比較搜尋結果之餘，也查查看航空公司本身的網站再下單有其回報。
hypothesis: 比較搜尋結果並在預訂前查看航空公司網站也很有價值.

source: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.
reference: 到某些國家旅遊或出差的短期停留可能不需要簽證，但以國際學生身分前往，需要待的時間通常比觀光客更長。
hypothesis: 旅行者或商務人士可能不需要簽證, 但當他們是留學者,

source: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.
reference: 通常，若要在外國居住一段較長的時間，你必須事先取得簽證。
hypothesis: 必須提前取得簽證.

source: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.
reference: 學生簽證的要求和申請程序通常與一般觀光或商務簽證不同。
hypothesis: 學生簽證通常與一般的旅遊或商務簽證有不同的要求和申請程序.

source: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.
reference: 在大部分的國家/地區，您都要提供欲就讀的教育機構所給的錄取通知書，同時也要提供至少能支持您完成第一年課程的財力證明。
hypothesis: 您需要在大部分國家獲得您希望在哪裡讀書的學院的招生信,

source: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.
reference: 請向您欲前往求學的機構及該國移民當局諮詢詳細要求。
hypothesis: 請與您希望在哪個國家學習的學校及移民局聯絡,

source: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.
reference: 除非你是外交官，否則在海外工作通常表示你必須在所在國家申報所得稅。
hypothesis: 沒有任何其他國家的移民,

source: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.
reference: 不同國家的所得稅結構各不相同，各國的稅率及等級差異也相當大。
hypothesis: 收入稅在不同國家的結構不同,

source: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.
reference: 在某些聯邦國家，例如美國和加拿大，聯邦政府和地方政府都課徵所得稅，因此稅率和稅級會因地區而有所不同。
hypothesis: 部分國家,如美國和加拿大, 所得稅既在聯邦,也在地方層面征收,

source: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.
reference: 回國時，可能不必經過移民署檢查，或僅是例行公事，但海關控管就可能十分惱人。
hypothesis: 移民檢查通常是沒有或是一個形式的當你抵達你的祖國,

source: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.
reference: 一定要知道可攜帶及不可攜帶的物品種類，若攜帶超出規定數量必須詳實申報。
hypothesis: 確保你知道你能帶進去什麼,

source: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.
reference: 進入遊記寫作產業最簡單的方式，就是在知名的旅遊部落格網站上鍛鍊你的技巧。
hypothesis: 旅遊部落格網站的經驗最簡單,

source: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.
reference: 待你熟悉在網路上編排格式和編輯後，說不定就能打造你自己的網站。
hypothesis: 您的網站可能會成為您的網站.

source: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.
reference: 旅行時參加志願活動是貢獻一己之力的好方法，而且這不只是單純給予。
hypothesis: 旅行時做志願活動是改變事物的好方法,

source: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.
reference: 在異國生活和當志工是接觸不同文化、認識新朋友、了解自己、取得某種看事情的角度，甚至是獲得新技能的一個好方法。
hypothesis: 能了解不同的文化,認識新人,了解自己,了解自己的角度,

source: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.
reference: 由於許多志願性的工作均提供食宿，而少數工作還支付微薄薪水，這也不失為放寬預算，以便在某個地方停留更久的好方法。
hypothesis: 還有許多志願者提供住宿和食物,

source: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.
reference: 維京人從俄羅斯的航道進入黑海和裏海。目前有一部份的航道仍可通行，請留意是否需要特殊許可，有些許可不易取得。
hypothesis: 維京人使用俄國水道前往黑海和海普海. 這些路線部分仍可使用.

source: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.
